Package options

Source: R/session.R
CausalStructures_options.Rd

CausalStructures reads the following options():

Details

CausalStructures.open

Logical, default TRUE. Default for the open argument of ancestors(), descendants(), possible_ancestors(), possible_descendants(), anteriors(), and posteriors(): TRUE (open definition) excludes the query node itself from the result, FALSE (closed definition) includes it.

The number of Julia threads is read from the JULIA_NUM_THREADS environment variable (a number or "auto") when the package is loaded, so set it before library(CausalStructures). More than one thread also turns on Julia's signal handling in the R process, which Julia's garbage collector needs for multi-threading.

The compiled library is looked up in the CAUSALSTRUCTURES_LIBRARY environment variable first (a path to the csjl shared library), then in the installed package's csjl directory (a development build), then where install_backend() builds it.
